biography.value: Frost Kin begin the cold stacking process that defines Ice Nephilim at higher tiers. Even at TR 1/2, a target that takes two or three Ice Slam hits will be moving at significantly reduced speed and suffering stacking cold conditions. Ice Stride's Difficult Terrain trail makes repositioning around them increasingly costly. A summoner who keeps a Frost Kin engaged with a single target will find that target significantly impaired within two rounds without necessarily taking catastrophic damage — the goal is impairment, not elimination.

system.attacksNotes:
Ice Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 2), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 8 damage (4 + 4 Str) + 2 cold damage (Half DR); target gains Chilled condition.
  • Margin 2: 8 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 cold damage; target gains Numbed condition; target's movement speed reduced by 10 until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 8 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 cold damage; target gains Frosted condition; movement speed reduced by 20 until end of their next turn.

Ice Shard [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 1), Range: 30 ft

  • Margin 1:: 10 cold damage (6 + 4 Dex); target gains Chilled.
  • Margin 2: 10 cold damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Numbed; movement speed reduced by 10.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Frost Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 5 feet take 2 cold damage (Half DR) and gain the Chilled condition. Powerful Build: Frost kin counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Ice Stride: Moves across ice and snow at full speed. Creates a thin frost trail wherever it walks; surfaces within 5 feet of its path become Difficult Terrain for 1 minute.
